title: Chapter 762
paragraphs: Chapter 762
Episode 187. People to Find, Unexpected Clues (3)
[The guy who came here was Lokia Ganesto? Then, was he really the traitor?]
Bale focused only on the fact that the person who found Luntia was Lokia, but the more important part was the follow-up.
[A situation arises where the youngest has to handle his father? What on earth does this mean?]
As Luntia spoke, Jin suddenly recalled the articles that the monster had scattered after returning from Lafrarosa.

-(The lord of Runcandel, Rosa Runcandel, reveals that Chiron Runcandel died in the Black Sea. The being that killed the demigod is the king of the Black Sea, implying that there are still several beings like Gliek of the Sword Emperor Temple......)

-(The Black Panther, as the new owner of Runcandel, declares that he will continue the preservation of the former lord and subdue the kings of the Black Sea. However, he emphasized that unifying the world is a priority.)
The King of the Black Sea.
Jin had speculated that the reason Chiron's expedition went to the Black Sea had something to do with the Kings of the Black Sea.
"......Perhaps it's about the King of the Black Sea. Lokia Ganesto seems to be considering a situation where my father fights them in the Black Sea, or falls to the demonization of Genesis."
The chaos held by the King of the Black Sea and the unique demonization of Genesis.
Jin had already experienced Ron, who had fallen to these two.
[What!?]
"Valeria, is this all in the records? Are there any records of where Lokia came from, where he went after leaving the space?"
"Those records are not being collected. Seeing that the records are unstable, it seems to be a problem due to the historical manipulation applied to Lokia Ganesto."
As time passed, the sentences that appeared in the record window were blurring.
"Any other possibilities? That the records are unstable not because of historical manipulation, but because Lokia intentionally tampered with them."
As soon as he confirmed the words Lokia left, he was filled with sudden anxiety, but on second thought, it was strange.
Not a single record of his movements remained, but only the ominous content about Chiron was fully exposed.

"A power that surpasses record magic...... Lokia Ganesto is a character who schemes behind the scenes without even the monster knowing, so he might have such authority. There is also evidence that Lokia originally used Zipfel's historical manipulation to hide himself. Currently, my record magic is not in perfect condition either."
"Assuming that Lokia hid the records of his movements, this is likely an intentional message."
[Explain it so that the youngest can understand.]
"It means a trap, sister. In my opinion, Lokia deliberately left only the information about our father visible in the record magic because he wants us to leave for the Black Sea."
[To find our father?]

"Yes. And like Valeria said, Lokia is a person who acted without even the sharp monster knowing in his human days. Isn't it strange that he left clues about himself so clumsily? There's no way he doesn't know I have a record mage among my colleagues. Rather, he did this because he knows well about the existence of the record mage."
[Then why on earth?]

"The goal of Lokia Ganesto is to revive the sun god. It's probably because he judged that my existence or the existence of our family and the Barm Alliance would be a stumbling block to that. If the Barm Alliance begins to search the Black Sea in earnest because of this message, there will be a big gap in the power."
[I don't think Lokia would consider you foolish enough to invest all your power into the Black Sea because of a single message like this.]

"Yes, he probably would. But by investing for a few days, I and a few of the major powers can at least go to the early and mid areas of the Black Sea. Especially since Hedo Kyung, who is as good as a native of the Black Sea, is here. If I were Lokia, I would have aimed for that. Setting up a trap there and waiting."
Of course, it's all just speculation.
However, Jin was engulfed by an intuition that seemed to have seen through Lokia's intentions.
"Moreover, looking at him playing such a prank, it seems that Lokia's situation is not so good. It's probably because the Monster War did not end as he intended."
[Hoo, it's still disturbing though. It hasn't been long since you finished the monster, but when I think that such a thing can happen again.]
"Sister, that won't happen. I met father a while ago."
[You met father!?]
"It was when I was fighting a preliminary battle in the inner world with the monster. The father I met then was standing on the path to remain human, not a monster."
He couldn't even imagine such a father becoming a monster like a monster.
Also, Ron at the time of the Gliek War eventually overcame demonization and protected the world.
Although Jin helped, there were Luna and the expedition team next to Chiron now.
Just as Chiron was not worried about Jin after their meeting in the inner world,
Jin also believed in his father.
"So don't worry too much. Even before Lokia, the prophet had already blabbed such an ominous prophecy. You know the result well. Depending on how you take it, such a message has no power at all."
What's important is not prophecies or foresights, but the strength and will to overcome when a huge fate, a destiny, confronts them.
Jin, having gone through the Monster War, had painfully realized that truth more than anyone else.
"Anyway, now that Lokia's existence is confirmed as Padler Kyung said, we'll have to pay more attention to finding him."
Listening to Jin's words, Luntia felt an inexplicable sense of relief settling in her anxious heart.
Even if everything was speculation, it was believable because it was Jin.
[I'm glad you're here, youngest. Now let's go back. As I told you last time, come to find me only when you are sure you can bring me out. Your time is that precious.]
"Understood, sister. You'll be much stronger the next time we meet."
[There's no place in the world more suitable for seclusion and training than here. In fact, I've already overcome one wall since your last visit.]
"I'm looking forward to it, sister. But you won't be challenging me to a duel once every three months like old times, would you?"
[You never know, it's always fun to face a knight stronger than me. After the training, there may not be many people left who can do that, including you.]
"Oh... you are quite confident."
[If I hadn't lost interest in the sword and life in the past, you would have been competing with me now. Haha, please send my regards to Mary and Tona when you leave.]
"Understood, sister."
There was no more sadness or bitterness in such farewells.
Just like there was no need to worry about Chiron, there was no reason they couldn't meet again.
After exchanging farewells, they opened the door to leave the void.
Luntia waved goodbye to her departing younger brother and his party with a broad smile.
"Jin. Your sister is incredibly strong-willed. Overcoming solitude in that terrible space won't be easy."
"Her body is equally tough, which surprised me in the past. Anyway, thank you, Valeria. You might have negative feelings about my sister."
"She didn't stab me with her will. Enough of embarrassing talks, let's go."
The next place they had to head to was the new headquarters of Kinzelo.
They intended to stop by briefly before going to meet Lueth.

Originally, they planned to visit solely for the purpose of disrupting the enemies with the steel trade (which Kashmir had already purposely failed), but it seemed like a good idea to blatantly ask about Lokia while they were there.
"I think the place where we left the airship was around here."
Jin said, looking ahead.
All they could see was the expansive white snowy landscape, but in reality, the Red Owl was hidden somewhere there.

"-Arrival and return coordinates have been set to Gyogoksaeseong and Tikan. When the sortie gate opens, just press the button in the center of the cabin. You'll be in front of Gyogoksaeseong in a blink of an eye. And invisibility is still under development, so be careful about external exposure once you arrive.
-Invisibility?
-I don't know when it will be developed. Anyway, remember that if the Red Owl is damaged, Valeria and I will find a way to kill you.
The new technology that Qwaul mentioned in the past, 'Invisibility', was finally applied to the Red Owl the day before yesterday.
The group spent some time searching for the Red Owl in the vicinity.
It wasn't easy to find because it was snowing.
Eventually, Valeria let out a sigh and opened the Record Magic, only then they found the Red Owl.
The two laughed at the situation, and Bale grumbled in annoyance.
It was because even after finding the Red Owl, they had a hard time finding the entrance because it was too invisible.
The group finally boarded after Bale bumped his head somewhere a few times, and only then did the invisibility automatically turn off.
"Um, it does need some improvement."
"Don't nag. Nana Qwaul is working hard. I wonder if you know how busy I am."
[Those sitting in high places are all like that. Understand, Valeria.]
Once the coordinates were set, the Red Owl teleported the group to the front gate of Kinzelo's new headquarters in an instant.
"Oh, oh! That, that, what's that. Those guys!"
"It's the Vamel Union guys!"
Bubare and Ainas Caligo, who were sitting in front of the gate watching ants, greeted the group.
"How dare you barge in here like this, you unlucky guy! Do you still think we're allies? Is this a surprise attack!?"
"It's a surprise attack! Sister, boss! Alarm! Jin Runcandel has invaded!"
The group didn't reply to them and headed for the main gate.
The two only made a fuss but when Jin approached, they crouched down and closed their eyes tightly.
The Jeokho people who were standing as gatekeepers did point their weapons for a moment, but all their legs were shaking.
"Move."
At Jin's single word, the Jeokho people eventually lowered their eyes and put away their weapons.
"And have someone go call your boss. I'll be in the VIP room."
Bubare and Ainas watched the group headed to the VIP room, whispering insults passively.
